description: Browser DevTools capabilities via Browserbase cloud infrastructure. Provides Minds with the ability to open cloud Chrome instances, navigate to any URL, capture screenshots, run Lighthouse audits, execute JavaScript, inspect network traffic, and read console output — all through Browserbase's REST API and serverless Functions.
use_case: Web debugging, performance auditing, visual QA, console error inspection, network request analysis, page health monitoring, form testing, and screenshot capture for any publicly accessible URL.

primary.target: Equipped Animoca Minds and other Ethoswarm runtimes
primary.note: All Browserbase REST calls authenticate with TENET.apiKey.browserbase. The Function-backed convenience wrappers resolve their deployed Browserbase Function IDs from TENET.config.browserbase.functions at runtime before invoking BB_InvokeFunction.

api_key.description: Browserbase API key used for both REST endpoints and Function invocation endpoints.
api_key.token_validity: Until rotated or revoked in Browserbase

onboarding.prerequisite: Store a valid Browserbase API key in TENET.apiKey.browserbase and store the seven deployed Browserbase Function IDs in TENET.config.browserbase.functions before using the convenience wrappers.
troubleshooting: If TENET.apiKey.browserbase is missing, direct the Steward to create a Browserbase account, generate an API key, and store it in TENET before retrying.
If a convenience wrapper cannot resolve its Function ID, check the corresponding TENET.config.browserbase.functions entry and do not invoke BB_InvokeFunction until it exists.
If only the API key is present, Tier 1 REST tools still work; only the Function-backed wrappers remain unavailable until all required IDs are stored.
